lesson.summary: Asserting a rule is STATED is not asserting it is OBSERVED, and a template is the artifact that gets copied
lesson.synthesized_rule: When a skill ships a template that a model will copy verbatim, a check that greps the surrounding PROSE for the rule passes while the template itself violates it. Three independent review lenses found exactly this: a marker rule was stated and the example beside it broke the rule twice. Assert against the rendered template, not only the prose that describes it -- the template is the spec.
